evidence: other-hosts-get-404 (nginx_static_domain.pp:236-245): FAIL. Lines declare a default_server on port 80 returning $default_str; the probe requests a NONEXISTENT path (/p8/phase3), which the domain's own server static_http_p8test.example.com also answers 404 (read-only curl on the applied node: Host p8test.example.com /p8/phase3 -> 404). Its varies claim 'serves www_root' is also wrong: Host p8test.example.com / returns 403 (no index.html, autoindex off), not content.
